subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Sprightly
solution:
The correct antonym of the word** 'sprightly'** is **'lethargic'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Explanation of options: 

 
• 1) **Lethargic** - feeling sluggish and lacking energy 
 
• 2) **Enthusiastic** - showing intense and eager enjoyment or interest 
 
• 3) **Durable** - able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage 
 
• 4) **Spiteful** - showing or caused by malice or ill will.

Therefore,** 'lethargic' **is the correct answer as it is the opposite of the meaning of '**sprightly**'.
